address.description: The host or host:port at which the database can be reached.
address.title: Server Address

advanced.description: Options for advanced users. You should not typically need to modify these.

discover_schemas.description: If this is specified only tables in the selected schema(s) will be automatically discovered. Omit all entries to discover tables from all schemas.
discover_schemas.title: Discovery Schema Selection

discover_views.description: When set views will be automatically discovered as resources. If unset only tables will be discovered.
discover_views.title: Discover Views

feature_flags.description: This property is intended for Estuary internal use. You should only modify this field as directed by Estuary support.
feature_flags.title: Feature Flags

poll.description: When and how often to execute fetch queries. Accepts a Go duration string like '5m' or '6h' for frequency-based polling or a string like 'daily at 12:34Z' to poll at a specific time (specified in UTC) every day. Defaults to '24h' if unset.
poll.title: Default Polling Schedule

source_tag.description: When set the capture will add this value as the property 'tag' in the source metadata of each document.
source_tag.title: Source Tag

sslmode.description: Overrides SSL connection behavior by setting the 'sslmode' parameter.
sslmode.title: SSL Mode

advanced.title: Advanced Options

database.description: Logical database name to capture from.

networkTunnel.description: Connect to your system through an SSH server that acts as a bastion host for your network.

knownHosts.description: Host keys of the SSH server in OpenSSH known_hosts format, one per line: the output of `ssh-keyscan -p 2222 bastion.example.com`, for example `[bastion.example.com]:2222 ssh-ed25519 AAAA...`.
knownHosts.title: SSH Known Hosts

privateKey.description: Private key to connect to the remote SSH server.
privateKey.title: SSH Private Key

skipHostKeyVerification.description: Connect without verifying the SSH server's host key.
skipHostKeyVerification.title: Skip Host Key Verification

sshEndpoint.description: Endpoint of the remote SSH server that supports tunneling (in the form of ssh://user@hostname[:port])
sshEndpoint.title: SSH Endpoint

networkTunnel.title: Network Tunnel

password.description: Password for the specified database user.

user.description: The database user to authenticate as.

cursor.description: The names of columns which should be persisted between query executions as a cursor.
cursor.title: Cursor Columns

name.description: The unique name of this resource.
name.title: Name

poll.description: When and how often to execute the fetch query (overrides the connector default setting). Accepts a Go duration string like '5m' or '6h' for frequency-based polling or a string like 'daily at 12:34Z' to poll at a specific time (specified in UTC) every day.
poll.title: Polling Schedule

schema.description: The name of the schema in which the captured table lives. The query template must be overridden if this is unset.
schema.title: Schema Name

table.description: The name of the table to be captured. The query template must be overridden if this is unset.
table.title: Table Name

template.description: Optionally overrides the query template which will be rendered and then executed. Consult documentation for examples.
template.title: Query Template Override
